prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1239
Claimant:
Ryan Roberts
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
June 27, 2024
Reported rear-end collision received and assigned for review. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further
contact will go through the attorney's office.
August 19, 2024
Vehicle inspection scheduled. The damage to the rear of the claimant's vehicle appears consistent with the impact
described in the first report.
August 20, 2024
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time of the collision and lists the other
driver's account.
August 28, 2024
Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed. They confirm some details of the damage and positioning, but no
independent witnesses have come forward.
September 27, 2024
Claimant's counsel submitted a medical summary describing neck and back strain. The reported injury is plausible for
a collision of this type and speed.
October 12, 2024
Recorded statement taken from the claimant. The account matches the one given at first notice and in the follow-up
call with the adjuster.
October 13, 2024
Records check completed. No prior injury to the same body area is known, and no earlier damage to the vehicle
appears in our file.
October 20, 2024
Repair estimate from before the policy start was located in the file. It lists damage to the same rear panels, which
conflicts with the claimant's account that the vehicle was undamaged beforehand.
November 18, 2024
Referred the repair estimate discrepancy to the supervisor for review. Requested an explanation from counsel and
the original repair facility.
November 26, 2024
Treatment records received. Care followed a typical course, with physical therapy and medication, and symptoms
eased steadily as the claimant improved.
December 19, 2024
Verified the insured driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force at the time of loss. Coverage confirmed
for the reported incident.
January 23, 2025
File reviewed with the supervisor. The injury claim remains open pending counsel's rseponse on the prior repair
estimate and a final review of the treatment billing.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
